title: Iranian Twin Sisters Reportedly Tortured In Protest Case; One Sentenced To Death
content: The family of 20-year-old Iranian twins Taraneh and Romina Rahimi says they have been tortured in prison and forced to confess to charges they deny.  Relatives say Taraneh was sentenced to death and Romina to 25 years in prison in Isfahan, where they were jailed in connection with mass protests.

title: From Al-Qaeda To Lone Wolves And AI: How Terrorism Has Changed Since 9/11
content: The 9/11 attacks were a global plot orchestrated by a Saudi millionaire whose Al-Qaeda network was later crippled by US-led military action. But experts warn today’s terrorists can be lone actors inspired online and harder to track, while Al-Qaeda is adapting to new technologies.
